subject.title: fix: active-memory recall fails with billing rejections on subscription-only Claude CLI setups

question: Should subscription-auth embedded dispatch be accepted as the proposed generic public PluginRuntime/RunEmbeddedAgent contract with Claude policy in core, or moved behind a provider-owned Claude CLI backend capability before merge?
rationale: Both shapes can fix the reproduced bug, but choosing the permanent API and ownership boundary changes compatibility obligations for plugins and future CLI providers; repository policy cannot safely infer that product and architecture intent.

options.title: Use provider-owned capability
options.body: Move Claude-specific subscription-auth eligibility onto CliBackendConfig or provider metadata and keep the embedded runner generic while retaining the proven execution and security mechanics.

options.title: Accept the proposed core contract
options.body: Approve the new public dispatch parameter and eligibility helper with the current Claude-only core policy, accepting its future compatibility and extension burden.

recommendation.title: Use provider-owned capability
recommendation.body: Move Claude-specific subscription-auth eligibility onto CliBackendConfig or provider metadata and keep the embedded runner generic while retaining the proven execution and security mechanics.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work is the strongest available history signal for plugin runtime contracts, activation boundaries, and active-memory runtime integration.
